# Sci-Fi Soldier / Futuristic Combat Trooper

- Author: ART_LOLL (`evgenytvidov` on Sketchfab)
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/sci-fi-soldier-futuristic-combat-trooper-de876bfdce1c47a4aa67670faee7208e
- Downloaded: 2026-09-19
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
- Attribution required on release: “Sci-Fi Soldier / Futuristic Combat Trooper” by ART_LOLL, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
- Asset: GLB, 2K textures, 84 MB.
- `trooper-compatible-rig.glb`: local adaptation with the project's `robot:rig:*` semantic hierarchy; no skinning and no embedded clips. It is driven by the existing renderer-only procedural animation controller.
- Status: local reference candidate only; not included in the game distribution or current player manifest.
changes: Baked imported transforms; normalized to 1.8m total height, feet origin
Welded coincident vertices preserving UV face corners and materials
Added humanoid armature, linear skinning, authored in-place and one-shot actions
v2: 30 digit bones, 4 forearm twist bones, topology-aware glove/pelvis weights, fixed-grip fitting
status: offline candidate; no runtime or manifest adoption
